justification: Inspected javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/resolution/Resolvable.java and found a 2-line interface with exactly one method, resolve(), so it is a minimal contract rather than an insufficiently modular class. Cross-checked usages in javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/expr/MethodCallExpr.java and javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/body/MethodDeclaration.java, where it is used as a simple marker-like capability on AST nodes, not as a class with multiple responsibilities.
